goal: Build and register a real pmcro-chief-executive-officer plugin (persona plus queue-intake skill), mirroring pmcro-chief-technology-officer's proven shape, and commit/push it scoped to only this cycle's files.

steps.description: Write skills/queue-intake/ in full (SKILL.md plus assets/{setup,tools,recipe}.queue-intake.asset.md plus references/README.md), grounded in a real live read of .pmcro/queue/ performed this cycle.
Add the new plugin's entry to .claude-plugin/marketplace.json as the 9th plugin, matching the existing entries' shape.
Git add exactly this cycle's files, commit, and push.
Independently re-verify every success criterion below against the real files and git history.

success_criteria: I confirm all pmcro-chief-executive-officer plugin files exist and are internally consistent with each other and with pmcro-chief-technology-officer's proven shape.

I confirm the queue-intake skill's assets describe only what was actually observed live in .pmcro/queue/ this cycle, with zero placeholder values, and honestly document the schema/real-item discrepancy rather than concealing it.
I confirm .claude-plugin/marketplace.json includes the new plugin entry, remains valid JSON, and matches the existing entries' shape.
I confirm no host-specific or drive-letter path appears anywhere in any new or edited file.
I confirm the git commit and push actually happened, verified independently rather than by trusting Maker's self-report.
out_of_scope: Making any real queue item actually adopt a Chief name in proposed_role -- this cycle documents the convention, it does not enact it on existing items.
Chartering any domain Chief beyond CEO.
Building an O-Mode state machine, a full C-Suite, or a pmcro-core engine.
